page.layout: One page of text, single column; page number at top centre above an ornament; heading "Liber Secundus." and "CAP. I." above the running text; signature "S 3" at foot left of centre. A small mark at the top left corner is not text. No margin notes.

l.i: In Genef.1.1, nonnulla explicanda & difpicienda proponuntur.
Talmudica commenta de mundi inchoati tempore inde eruta.

ano commemorata. Johannis 8.25. frustra huc trahitur. Ve-
ritas à mendacio fuppetias non poftulat. Verficulus Mofis

בראשית non femper in rectionis ftructurâ. Amos

page.notes: The Hebrew words (בראשית, and the Hebrew word after "Hof.1.1.") and the Greek-looking marks are printed in Hebrew letters; the Hebrew in the line "Amos 4.11" and the Hebrew word "הבית" after Hof.1.1 are only approximate. Left-margin and right-margin text is absent. The last word "mundum" is the catchword and is also repeated at line end; the catchword is printed at the foot right. Some words in the grey lower lines (membrum, compositi) are faint and may be imprecise. The running head is absent.
